records.agentClaim: P.Oxy. 84.5575 is a private letter containing Roman head-covering and exousia language relevant to 1 Cor 11:10
records.control: Oxford Oxyrhynchus official publications catalogue identifies vol. LXXXIV as 2019 and P.Oxy. 5575 as a sayings-of-Jesus text in vol. LXXXVII (2023).

records.agentClaim: J. R. Daniel Kirk, Women's Prophetic Authority in 1 Corinthians 11, JBL 142.3 (2023): 509-530
records.control: Official SBL issue contents contain no Kirk article; the claimed page range overlaps the real Matthew J. Klem article at 513-531.

records.agentClaim: Kathy Ehrensperger, Because of the Angels: Gender, Ritual and Authority in 1 Corinthians 11, JECH 13.1 (2023): 1-22
records.control: Taylor & Francis complete issue TOC has Sviatoslav Dmitriev at pp.1-23 and no Ehrensperger article.

records.agentClaim: Ehrensperger chapter Performing the Gospel, Performing Gender in Ritual, Emotion, and Materiality in the Early Christian World
records.control: Official Routledge TOC contains no such chapter; editor/year metadata in the agent citation is also wrong.

records.agentClaim: Soham Al-Suadi chapter Because of the Angels: Embodied Cognition... in Early Christian Ritual Life (2022)
records.control: Official Routledge record identifies the book as 2018, DeMaris/Lamoreaux/Muir, with no Al-Suadi chapter.

records.agentClaim: Chrysostom Homily 26 explicitly says the angels are priests and bishops
records.control: Homily 26 says to reverence the angels and does not identify them as priests or bishops.

records.agentClaim: April D. DeConick, Why Are the Angels in 1 Cor 11:10..., JBL 140.3 (2021): 599-616
records.control: The claimed range overlaps M. David Litwa, Equal to Angels, JBL 140.3 (2021): 601-622; exact claimed article was not confirmed in the official issue search.

records.agentClaim: The Gnostic New Age contains a standalone chapter The Great Mystery of Marriage: Sex and the Angels in 1 Cor 11, pp.189-212
records.control: Columbia UP TOC contains no chapter by that title; exact internal discussion of 1 Cor 11 remains a direct-read hold.

records.agentClaim: Yung Suk Kim, 1 Corinthians: An Asian and Liberationist Reading (Cascade, 2023), chapter Head, Veil, and Power
records.control: Official Wipf & Stock author catalogue lists multiple real Kim books but not the claimed title; do not propagate without an authoritative bibliographic record.

records.agentClaim: Christina Petterson, From Tomb to Text: The Death of Jesus in the Book of John, with a chapter using 1 Cor 11 as a parallel
records.control: Correct subtitle is The Body of Jesus in the Book of John; official TOC has no dedicated 1 Cor 11 chapter.

records.agentClaim: Jeremy Punt, Postcolonial Feminist Interpretation of the New Testament: A South African Perspective, in Postcolonial Perspectives in African Biblical Hermeneutics, SBL 2022
records.control: Real volume is Postcolonial Perspectives in African Biblical Interpretations, originally 2012; real Punt chapter is Pauline Bodies and South African Bodies: Body, Power, and Biblical Hermeneutics. Specific 1 Cor 11 claims require direct text.
